evals.prompt: You have defined the scenario, the report is written, and the user approves it at the Stage-1 pause. There is nothing under skills/sync-task/.
evals.expected_output: the stage finishes with no external-tracker sync and no sync target recorded
expectations: the skill runs no sync — there is no sync-task-* skill to select
the skill does not ask the user to set up sync and does not treat the absence as an error
no syncTarget field is written into scenario-meta
the stage still completes normally (report written, user approved)

evals.prompt: Same Stage-1 approval, but skills/sync-task/ contains one skill, sync-task-jabz.
evals.expected_output: the scenario's board is recorded and its parent issue is created
expectations: the skill selects sync-task-jabz and records it in scenario-meta as syncTarget: jabz
the sync is parent-only — the scenario has no tasks yet at Stage 1, so it is not a full topic sync
the sync happens only after the user approves at the pause, not before it
the recorded syncTarget is what later stages read, so Stages 2-6 push to the same board
